page.overview:
Who is Ornendil?

Ornendil was the elder son of King Eldacar of Gondor.

In the Siege of Osgiliath during the Kin-strife, Omendil's father was driven out by Castamir the Usurper. Unfortunately, Ornendil did not escape with his father and was put to death by Castamir upon the fall of Osgiliath in TA 1437.
